component.name: Ragnaros
component.summary: Driver and daemon for the Redragon SS552 Ragnaros USB control deck

description.p: A reverse-engineered userspace driver for the Redragon SS552 "Ragnaros" control deck. Its daemon paints icons and animated GIFs on the deck's ten LCD keys and four-panel touch strip, and runs a command for every key, knob, tap and swipe, as mapped in YAML profiles.
